BUILD scripts/obe_fix_consumer.py — the deterministic FIX-comment consumer:
1. Flow per open '[send-approval]' card (default read-only dry run; --execute required for writes, mirroring the executor's convention): find the NEWEST human comment whose first line is exactly 'FIX' or starts with 'FIX:' or 'FIX ' (case-sensitive first token; comments whose first line starts with an agent taxonomy marker are ignored — humans only, same discipline as APPROVE resolution in the executor; read how the executor distinguishes human comments and copy that mechanism faithfully).
2. If the FIX comment contains replacement text (everything after the first line, stripped, non-empty): (a) fetch the card's gmail_draft_id from its gate packet (parse the card body/packet the same way the executor does); (b) via an injected Gmail drafts service, UPDATE the draft's body to the replacement text while PRESERVING to/cc/bcc/subject/threadId exactly (read the bridge for how it reads drafts; use users().drafts().update with a rebuilt MIME message that copies the original headers — never touch recipients); (c) re-run the SAME deterministic voice-QA gate the bridge uses on the new text (import or replicate its check exactly — read the bridge's QA function and reuse via import if importable, else extract the call); (d) post ONE card comment (first line an agent taxonomy marker per the open-engine card format, built via ~/scripts/open_engine_card_format.py agent_comment if importable, else a plain 'AGENT:' first line) reporting: draft updated, QA verdict (pass or the named defects), and 'reply APPROVE external_send to send, SKIP to discard'.
3. If the FIX comment has NO replacement text: post one comment explaining the grammar (put the new full text under the FIX line, or edit the draft directly in Gmail) — and do nothing else.
4. Idempotency: a ledger JSONL (path via --ledger, default state/fix_consumer_ledger.jsonl under the repo) keyed by comment id — a FIX comment is consumed at most once, ever, including across retries; append with fsync.
5. Fail closed everywhere: missing draft, missing packet, adapter error, ambiguous multiple FIX comments (take newest only), QA machinery unavailable -> log via logging module, post NO comment claiming success, nonzero exit. --execute required for: draft update, comment posting, ledger append. Dry run prints a JSON plan {cards, fixes_found, would_update} and exits 0.
6. CLI: --execute, --ledger, --limit (max cards per run, default 20), --team-key default ANK. Injectable seams: adapter factory and gmail service factory as module-level callables (monkeypatchable), exactly like tests need.
